G=[[1,1,1,4],[9,1,1,2],[5,2,1,1],[5,2,4,1]]
n=len(G)
cw=[[G[n-1-r][c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
ccw=[[G[r][n-1-c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
r180=[row[::-1] for row in G[::-1]]
out=[G[r]+cw[r] for r in range(n)]+[ccw[r]+r180[r] for r in range(n)]
print(out)
